notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight additional creatures, five of which must be Myrs.
description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Myrs, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 2 one additional time.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Urtet triggers, untapping each Myr you control.
Repeat step 2 two additional times.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
